title: 2008 HMMT November General Round 2 Problem 1
statement: Joe B. first places the black king in one corner of the board. In how many of the 35 remaining squares can he place a white bishop so that it does not check the black king?

solutions.text: 180 Observe that \(9^{2}+40^{2}=41^{2}\), so this triangle is right and therefore has area \(\frac{1}{2} \cdot 9 \cdot 40=\) 180.
